name: 18 Scorpii
description: A naked-eye star 13.9 parsecs away, 1.2 times the Sun's width: its disc was measured with the CHARA Array.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 146233: radius in solar radii, from the limb-darkened angular diameter 0.78 +/- 0.017 mas (CHARA) and the Hipparcos parallax, 1.166 +/- 0.026

mass.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 146233: mass in solar masses, from Yonsei-Yale isochrones at the measured radius and temperature (a model value), 0.887 +/- 0.019

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 146233: effective temperature in K, from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux, 5433 +/- 69

distance.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 146233: the Hipparcos parallax the radius was computed with (van Leeuwen 2007), 71.93 +/- 0.37 mas, inverted

text.card: A naked-eye star 14 parsecs away whose disc the CHARA Array measured: 1.2 times the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Its disc spans 0.78 milliarcseconds, which gives 1.166 solar radii and 5,433 K at its surface.
text.locator: Tables 5 and 10, HD 146233: limb-darkened diameter, R, Teff
